name: GreenCloud VPS
line: Rent KVM virtual servers with SSD or NVMe storage.

free.text: No free VPS tier; promotional annual plans are listed

work.math: The published offer is $25 a year, not a monthly rate. It includes 4 TB of transfer a month and one IPv4 address for the yearly term.
The $25 a year Chicago DC2 plan includes 4 TB of transfer a month. No monthly billing rate is published, and no request meter is listed.
The $25 a year plan has 35 GB of NVMe storage and one snapshot. The price for daily scheduled backups is not published.
